answer: Require every agent to post a refundable stake into a shared harbor registry before trading, with the stake released only after a history of independently verified work. A new identity starts with a violet badge marking it unproven, so partners cap its transaction size until its record grows. Forging one identity is cheap, but forging a thousand proven histories means funding a thousand stakes and paying for a thousand verified jobs, while a single fraud burns the stake like an ember that consumes its own fuel. Sybil scale therefore costs real capital and time, not just new names.
